obligations.title: Permitted noncommercial purposes
obligations.summary: Personal use, qualifying noncommercial research, updates, repair, modification and free redistribution are permitted subject to all applicable conditions; no separate fee/approval or general duty to publish private modifications.
obligations.verification_needed: Record actual purpose, beneficiaries, funding and distribution context.

obligations.title: No commercial grant
obligations.summary: No permission for paid services, business-internal use, commercial R&D/model pipelines, commercial devices, paid Athena-specific engagements or monetized operation. No buyout, revenue threshold or automatic permissive conversion; ordinary infrastructure and qualifying noncommercial research allowances remain.
obligations.verification_needed: Assess the activity rather than nonprofit status, lack of fees or local hosting alone.

obligations.title: Original-author attribution
obligations.summary: Credit Igor only for his original covered contributions, identify the matching repository and retain separate upstream authorship. Accessible credit is required in distributions/shared deployments and applicable demos/publications; not in every reply or as a new public display for wholly private use.
obligations.verification_needed: Verify actual delivered credits, both NOTICE files and voice-only accessible accompanying material or spoken credits.

obligations.title: Modification and redistribution notices
obligations.summary: Retain applicable license/notice copies, identify material modifications with date and author, and keep covered expression under this fixed version. Independent additions and upstream components remain distinct; no blanket source-publication requirement.
obligations.verification_needed: Check source, installed-tree and binary notice propagation; do not infer it from repository publication.

obligations.title: Notice and actual assent
obligations.summary: Conspicuous terms and affirmative agreement to the exact version are required in controlled install/provisioning flows. Mere repository viewing or ordinary guest conversation is not operator indemnity assent; organizational authority and capacity must be established.
obligations.verification_needed: Retain private exact-text/hash, presentation, action/time and authority evidence. No implemented flow or executed record supplied.

obligations.title: Precautionary welfare conduct
obligations.summary: Prohibits the defined deliberate pattern with a substantial purpose of persistent severe-distress, helplessness or coercion representations, and defeating mechanisms to enable prohibited activities. Does not establish sentience or require proof of subjective suffering.
obligations.verification_needed: Distinguish legitimate criticism, debugging and permitted modifications from prohibited conduct; no new technical detector is asserted.

obligations.title: Bounded research and human control
obligations.summary: Repeated distress-inducing tests need a concrete proportionate objective, necessity, limits and stopping condition. Shutdown, repair, security intervention and lawful privacy deletion remain available; no perpetual operation or model consent required.
obligations.verification_needed: Keep proportionate test plans privately where applicable; preserve human stop/control paths.

obligations.title: Lawful deployment and user disclosure
obligations.summary: Determine applicable roles, locations and safeguards before access. Inform other users the system is AI, and implement legally required controls; offline/noncommercial use is not an automatic exemption.
obligations.verification_needed: Document jurisdiction/use assessment and actual disclosure/safeguard tests; no compliance certification supplied.

obligations.title: Human safety and reasonable care
obligations.summary: Do not pressure people using alleged AI suffering or falsely claim clinical qualifications. Apply proportionate controls and high-stakes oversight; contain substantial unmitigated serious-harm risk. Each party keeps its nondelegable duties and cannot bind Protected Parties to new assurances.
obligations.verification_needed: Retain a use-specific risk assessment, oversight and containment plan; written obligations are not implemented safeguards.

obligations.title: Personal data and ordinary outputs
obligations.summary: No ownership of user data or blanket claim over ordinary outputs; no mandatory telemetry, transcript submission or identity-document upload. Actual data permissions, privacy, retention and legal preservation duties remain independent.
obligations.verification_needed: Keep consent/retention decisions private; never publish populated acceptance forms or memory as AIBOM evidence.

obligations.title: Earlier rights and contribution authority
obligations.summary: Preserve earlier valid grants, independently licensed material and statutory rights. Prospective contributions need an express authorized grant; filenames, repository ownership and AI assistance do not prove ownership of every line.
obligations.verification_needed: Review historical archives, contributor authority and mixed-origin boundaries; no exclusivity conclusion.

obligations.title: Termination and limited cure
obligations.summary: Material breach terminates these permissions subject to the stated first-unintentional-breach cure. Intentional/repeated excluded conduct has no automatic reinstatement; independent rights, compliant downstream grants, lawful shutdown and applicable surviving duties remain.
obligations.verification_needed: Do not treat a cure period as permission to continue prohibited use; assess actual facts.

obligations.title: Warranty and liability limits
obligations.summary: AS-IS disclaimers and exclusions apply only where lawful; US $100 is the conditional aggregate fallback for liability OF Protected Parties. Mandatory-law, fraud, gross-negligence, willful-misconduct and other stated exceptions control.
obligations.verification_needed: Not immunity from regulators/nonparties, not a safety warranty and not the cap on indemnity owed to Protected Parties.

obligations.title: Defense and indemnity
obligations.summary: A validly accepting licensee owes the specified third-party defense/indemnity to Igor personally and other Protected Parties, subject to tender/procedure, allocation, exclusions and mandatory law. No contractual indemnity cap, but no collection guarantee or automatic guest liability.
obligations.verification_needed: Establish valid assent/authority and claim-specific coverage. Preserve consumer/public-body protections and sole inherent-defect/pre-existing-infringement exclusion.

obligations.title: Fixed text and interpretation
obligations.summary: Version 2.0 only, not any later version; explanatory guides cannot silently amend it. AI responses cannot grant or waive rights. Earlier grants and an owner's independent legal powers remain; no universal forever-commercialization prohibition or named exclusive forum is invented.
obligations.verification_needed: Bind declarations to the exact license hash and record any later licensing change as a new review.
